fact: ARCEP, Niger's telecoms regulator, launched a public consultation on 20 July 2026, running to the end of August, on reorganising the spectrum plan for 5G.

The Agence Nigerienne de Presse reports that the national communication observatory held a two-day workshop in Maradi on 18-19 May 2026 with journalists, online media promoters, web-activists and influencers to review and amend the draft ordinance on the electronic press, including regulation of social networks and platforms.
